sentences.en: There is more pleasure in loving than in being loved.
sentences.zh: 比起被人爱，去爱人更有乐趣。

sentences.en: That man is the richest whose pleasures are the cheapest.
sentences.zh: 那个能让别人免费享受最多快乐的人才是最富有的人。

sentences.en: I'll help you with pleasure if you want me to.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要我帮忙的话，我很乐意提供帮助。

senses.zh: 快乐，满足，欣慰；乐事，趣事；（尤指工作、职责之外的）娱乐，消遣
